params.name: oCell

params.description: Add a new column before or after the specified cell. If no cell is specified,then this parameter will be ignored.

AddColumns.description: Adds the new columns to the current table.

params.description: The cell after which the new columns will be added. If not specified, the new columns will be added at the end of the table.
params.name: oCell

params.description: Count of columns to be added.
params.name: nCount

params.description: Adds the new columns before (true) or after (false) the specified cell.
params.name: isBefore

params.name: oCell

params.description: The position in the cell where the specified element will be added.

AddRow.description: Adds a new row to the current table.

params.description: If not specified, a new row will be added to the end of the table.

AddRows.description: Adds the new rows to the current table.

params.name: oCell

params.description: Count of rows to be added.

params.description: Adds the new rows before (true) or after (false) the specified cell.
params.name: isBefore

MergeCells.description:
Merges an array of cells. If merge is successful, it will return merged cell, otherwise "null".
**Warning**: The number of cells in any row and the number of rows in the current table may be changed.

params.description: The array of cells.
params.name: aCells

RemoveColumn.description: Removes a table column with the specified cell.

params.description: The table cell from the column which will be removed.
params.name: cell

returns.description: result of deletion. When the last column is removed, the whole table is deleted from the slide.

RemoveRow.description: Removes a table row with the specified cell. When the last row is removed, the whole table is deleted from the slide

params.description: The table cell from the row which will be removed.

SetHeight.description:
Sets the total height of the current table, distributing it evenly among the table rows.
The value is applied as a minimum height for each row, so a row can be taller if its content requires more space.

params.description: The table height in English measure units.
params.name: height

SetHyperlink.description:

returns.description: Returns true if the hyperlink was set or removed successfully.

SetTableLook.description:
Specifies the components of the conditional formatting of the referenced table style (if one exists)
which shall be applied to the set of table rows with the current table-level property exceptions. A table style
can specify up to six different optional conditional formats [Example: Different formatting for first column],
which then can be applied or omitted from individual table rows in the parent table.

The default setting is to apply the row and column banding formatting, but not the first row, last row, first
column, or last column formatting.

params.description: Specifies that the first column conditional formatting shall be applied to the    table.
params.name: isFirstColumn

params.description: Specifies that the first row conditional formatting shall be applied to the table.
params.name: isFirstRow

params.description: Specifies that the last column conditional formatting shall be applied to the    table.
params.name: isLastColumn

params.description: Specifies that the last row conditional formatting shall be applied to the table.
params.name: isLastRow

params.description: Specifies that the horizontal banding conditional formatting shall not be applied    to the table.
params.name: isHorBand

params.description: Specifies that the vertical banding conditional formatting shall not be applied to    the table.
params.name: isVerBand

SetTableLook.signature: SetTableLook(isFirstColumn: boolean, isFirstRow: boolean, isLastColumn: boolean, isLastRow: boolean, isHorBand: boolean, isVerBand: boolean): void
